name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to all land-holding farmer families across the country, payable in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts via DBT.
detailed_description: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme that provides income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and for domestic needs. Under the scheme, ₹6,000 per year is provided to eligible farmer families payable in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly to bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
application_process: 1. Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in). 2. Click 'New Farmer Registration'. 3. Enter Aadhaar number and state. 4. Fill in personal and land details. 5. Submit and verify via OTP. Alternatively, visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or gram panchayat.
source_name: pmkisan.gov.in (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare)

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
department: Department of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Free LPG connection with first refill and hotplate to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) and other deprived households to replace unclean cooking fuels.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) was launched with the objective of safeguarding the health of women and children by providing them clean cooking fuel - LPG, so that they don't have to compromise their health in smoky kitchens or wander in jungles in search of firewood. Under PMUY 2.0, expanded to cover more categories including migrants.
benefits: Free LPG connection, first LPG refill free, LPG stove/hotplate. Security deposit waived.
documents: BPL ration card or any one of 14 specified documents as alternative
Self-declaration of not having LPG connection
application_process: 1. Visit nearest LPG distributor (HP Gas, Bharat Gas, or Indane). 2. Fill Form KYC1 and Form PMUY. 3. Submit documents. 4. Verification done by distributor. 5. Connection released after approval. Online application at pmuy.gov.in.
source_name: pmuy.gov.in (Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas)

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
department: National Health Authority
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to bottom 40% economically vulnerable families.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) is the world's largest health insurance/ assurance scheme. It provides health cover of ₹5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. Over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries) are eligible. The scheme covers pre and post-hospitalization expenses, 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization.
benefits: ₹5,00,000 health coverage per family per year for hospitalization. Covers 1,949 medical procedures. Cashless and paperless treatment at empanelled hospitals. No restriction on family size, age, or gender.
application_process: 1. Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in using your mobile/ration card number. 2. If eligible, generate your Ayushman card at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), empanelled hospital, or via Ayushman app. 3. Show Ayushman card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit scheme for street vendors to avail affordable working capital loan starting from ₹10,000 to restart livelihoods. Loans up to ₹50,000 available on repayment.
detailed_description: PM SVANidhi is a special micro-credit facility scheme for street vendors affected by COVID-19. It provides collateral-free working capital loans of ₹10,000 (1st loan), ₹20,000 (2nd loan), ₹50,000 (3rd loan) to approximately 50 lakh street vendors. Incentive for digital transactions – up to ₹1,200 per annum. Subsidy of 7% on interest.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan: ₹10,000 (1st), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd). 7% interest subsidy. Digital transaction incentive up to ₹1,200/year. Credit score building.
documents: Vending certificate or Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body
application_process: 1. Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or via lending institutions. 2. Contact nearest Urban Local Body (ULB) for vending certificate. 3. Approach scheduled commercial banks, MFIs, or NBFCs. 4. Submit application with documents.
source_name: pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs)

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Ministry of MSME
description: Holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople including recognition, skill upgradation, credit support, and market linkage to strengthen their livelihoods.
detailed_description: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme launched for traditional artisans and craftspeople. The scheme provides recognition as Vishwakarma through PM Vishwakarma certificate, skill training (5-7 days basic, 15 days advanced), toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, credit support (collateral-free loans of ₹1 lakh in 1st tranche, ₹2 lakh in 2nd tranche at 5% concessional rate), digital and green incentives, and market linkage.
benefits: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive. Skill training with ₹500/day stipend. Collateral-free loan: ₹1 lakh (1st), ₹2 lakh (2nd) at 5% interest. Digital transaction incentive ₹1/transaction up to ₹100/month. PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card.
application_process: 1. Apply through Common Service Centres (CSC). 2. Visit pmvishwakarma.gov.in. 3. Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) at CSC will register the artisan. 4. Verification by Gram Panchayat/Urban Local Body and District Implementation Committee. 5. Certificate issued after approval.

name: PM MUDRA Yojana – Shishu
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services
description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹50,000 for micro-enterprises and small businesses under the Mudra Shishu category to start or expand business activities.
detailed_description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) provides loans through Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency (MUDRA) to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro-enterprises. Shishu: up to ₹50,000; Kishore: ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh; Tarun: ₹5,00,001 to ₹10 lakh. No collateral required. For manufacturing, trading, and services sector.
benefits: Collateral-free loan up to ₹50,000 (Shishu). No processing fee for Shishu loans. Flexible repayment up to 5 years. MUDRA card for working capital.
documents: Business plan / proof of business activity
application_process: 1. Visit any scheduled commercial bank, MFI, or NBFC. 2. Fill MUDRA loan application form. 3. Submit business plan and documents. 4. Bank processes and disburses loan. Apply online at udyamimitra.in.

name: National Scholarship Portal – Post-Matric Scholarship (SC Students)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education in India to provide financial assistance to complete higher education.
detailed_description: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students is one of the flagship schemes for SC students. It covers students studying at Post-Matric or Post-Secondary stage in Government/Government-aided educational institutions. Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance, study tour charges, thesis typing/printing charges for research scholars.
benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement. Maintenance allowance: ₹1,200/month (hostellers) to ₹550/month (day scholars) for degree/post-graduate. Book allowance and study tour charges. Thesis printing charges for research scholars.
application_process: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Fill application form with required details. 3. Upload documents. 4. Submit application. 5. Institute verifies. 6. State/UT verifies and forwards. 7. Scholarship credited to bank account.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of Higher Education
description: Scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate studies in colleges and universities, with preference to those from top 20 percentile of Class 12.
detailed_description: Central Sector Scholarship (CSS) for College and University Students is awarded to meritorious students who are in top 20 percentile of their Class 12 board exam. Scholarships are renewed annually subject to satisfactory progress. The scheme covers 82,000 fresh scholarships per year (41,000 boys + 41,000 girls).
benefits: ₹10,000/year for first 3 years (UG). ₹20,000/year for 4th and 5th year (professional courses). ₹20,000/year for PG students.
application_process: 1. Register at National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Apply under 'Central Schemes' → CSS. 3. Fill application and upload documents. 4. Submit before deadline (usually October each year). 5. Institute verification. 6. Scholarship credited.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Posts / Banks
description: Small savings scheme for girl children under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign. Offers higher interest rate and tax benefits for securing girl's education and marriage expenses.
detailed_description: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) is a government-backed savings scheme specifically for girls. Account can be opened for girl child up to 10 years of age by parent/guardian. Minimum deposit ₹250/year, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/year. Interest rate: 8.2% p.a. (Q4 FY2024, subject to quarterly revision). Tax benefits under Section 80C. Partial withdrawal allowed at 18 for education. Account matures at 21 years.
benefits: 8.2% p.a. interest (one of the highest for small savings). Tax-free interest and maturity amount. Section 80C deduction up to ₹1.5 lakh/year. Minimum deposit ₹250/year.
documents: Aadhaar card / Passport of girl and guardian
application_process: 1. Visit any post office or authorized bank (SBI, BOB, PNB, etc.). 2. Fill SSY account opening form. 3. Submit documents and initial deposit (minimum ₹250). 4. Account number and passbook issued.

name: PMEGP (PM Employment Generation Programme)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
department: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises in non-farm sector to generate employment opportunities in rural and urban areas.
detailed_description: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises. For General Category: 15% subsidy (urban), 25% (rural). For SC/ST/Women/differently-abled/NE States/Hill/Border: 25% subsidy (urban), 35% (rural). Maximum project cost: ₹50 lakh (manufacturing), ₹20 lakh (service). Own contribution: 10% for general, 5% for special categories.
benefits: Subsidy: 15-35% of project cost. Maximum project: ₹50 lakh (manufacturing), ₹20 lakh (service). No collateral for loans up to ₹10 lakh under CGTMSE.
application_process: 1. Register at kviconline.gov.in/pmegp. 2. Fill online application. 3. Submit to KVIC/KVIB/DIC. 4. Score card prepared. 5. Interview before task force committee. 6. Loan from bank. 7. Subsidy released to bank.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Housing for All scheme providing financial assistance to urban poor for construction/acquisition of pucca house with basic amenities. Covers EWS, LIG, and MIG categories.
detailed_description: PMAY-U aims to provide housing for all in urban areas by 2024. Benefits: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) – interest subsidy on home loans for EWS/LIG/MIG. In-situ slum redevelopment. Affordable housing in partnership. Beneficiary-led construction. EWS: Annual income up to ₹3 lakh, LIG: ₹3-6 lakh, MIG-I: ₹6-12 lakh, MIG-II: ₹12-18 lakh.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loan: EWS/LIG up to ₹2.67 lakh. Preference to women as property owner. SC/ST/differently-abled/minorities given preference. Beneficiary-led construction subsidy of ₹1.5 lakh.
documents: Swachh Bharat Mission toilet registration (if applicable)
application_process: 1. Visit PMAY-U portal at pmaymis.gov.in. 2. Check eligibility. 3. Apply via Urban Local Body (ULB) or online portal. 4. For CLSS: Apply through empanelled Primary Lending Institutions (PLIs). 5. Submit documents. 6. Subsidy credited to loan account.
source_name: pmaymis.gov.in (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs)

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
description: Government-backed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers to provide guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60.
detailed_description: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) focuses on the unorganized sector workers. Under APY, a subscriber receives a fixed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month from age 60, depending on contribution amount. Government contributes 50% of subscriber's contribution (max ₹1,000/year) for 5 years for those who joined before March 2016. Account holders should not be income tax payers (from 2022 onwards).
benefits: Guaranteed pension ₹1,000-₹5,000/month from age 60. Spouse continues pension on subscriber's death. Nominee receives accumulated pension wealth on death. Tax benefit under Section 80CCD.
application_process: 1. Visit any bank branch, post office, or apply online via net banking. 2. Fill APY subscriber registration form. 3. Link savings bank account for auto-debit of contributions. 4. Account opened and contribution auto-debited monthly.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services
description: Life insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh coverage for accidental/natural death at an annual premium of just ₹436. Available to individuals aged 18-50 with a bank account.
detailed_description: PMJJBY offers life insurance of ₹2 lakh for one year renewable term at premium of ₹436 per year. It covers death due to any cause. The premium is auto-debited from the bank account. Available to people having a bank/post office savings account in the age group 18-50 years. Renewable every year on June 1.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover for death due to any reason. Annual premium: ₹436 (auto-debited). Simple enrollment through bank.
application_process: 1. Visit your bank branch or apply via net banking/mobile banking. 2. Fill consent-cum-declaration form. 3. Auto-debit of ₹436 from bank account annually. 4. Insurance coverage active for one year (June 1 to May 31).

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
department: Department of Financial Services
description: Accidental death and disability insurance scheme providing ₹2 lakh coverage at an annual premium of just ₹20 for people aged 18-70.
detailed_description: PMSBY offers accidental death and disability insurance of ₹2 lakh at annual premium of ₹20. ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability. The premium is auto-debited from bank account. Available to people aged 18-70 with a bank/post office savings account. Annual renewal on June 1.
benefits: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability. ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability. Annual premium only ₹20.
application_process: 1. Visit bank branch or apply via net banking/mobile banking. 2. Give consent for auto-debit. 3. ₹20 debited annually. 4. Coverage active June 1 to May 31.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
description: Scholarship for meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropout rate at Class 8 and encourage them to continue secondary and higher secondary education.
detailed_description: NMMS is awarded to students studying in Class 9 to 12 in government/government-aided/local body schools. Selected through State-level Means-cum-Merit examination. One lakh scholarships are awarded every year. Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000/month) disbursed through DBT.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) via DBT. For students in Class 9-12. Renewable annually.
application_process: 1. Appear in NMMS examination conducted by State/UT in November. 2. If selected, register at scholarships.gov.in. 3. Apply online with documents. 4. School verification. 5. State authority verification. 6. Scholarship credited.

name: National Scholarship – Post-Matric for OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scholarship for Other Backward Class (OBC) students pursuing post-matriculation studies to provide financial assistance to complete higher education.
detailed_description: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students provides financial assistance to backward class students studying at post-matric or post-secondary stage. Covers tuition fee, maintenance allowance, book allowance, and other charges. Annual income ceiling: ₹1 lakh. State governments implement the scheme.
benefits: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of fees. Varies by state and course. Book allowance included.
application_process: 1. Register at National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Apply under 'State Schemes' for your state's OBC scholarship. 3. Upload documents. 4. Submit before deadline. 5. Institute and state verification. 6. Scholarship credited.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls (Technical Education)
ministry: Ministry of Education
department: AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education)
description: Scholarship to girl students pursuing technical education (degree and diploma) in AICTE-approved institutions. Up to ₹50,000 per year to cover tuition fee and incidental expenses.
detailed_description: AICTE Pragati Scholarship aims to provide assistance to the girl students for pursuing their education in AICTE-approved institutions. 4,000 scholarships are provided annually. One scholarship per family – only one girl beneficiary per family per year. Eligible for degree (₹50,000/year) and diploma (₹30,000/year) level courses.
benefits: ₹50,000/year for degree students. ₹30,000/year for diploma students. Covers tuition fee and incidental expenses. One girl per family.
application_process: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Apply under 'Central Schemes' → AICTE Pragati. 3. Fill form and upload documents. 4. Submit before deadline. 5. Institute verification. 6. Scholarship credited.

name: PM Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces and Paramilitary
ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs
department: Ministry of Home Affairs
description: Scholarship for wards and widows of CAPF/RPF/RPSF/State Police personnel killed or disabled in action to promote higher technical and professional education.
detailed_description: PM Scholarship Scheme for CAPF/RPF/RPSF provides scholarships to wards and widows of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) and Railway Protection Force (RPF) personnel killed or disabled in action or died/disabled due to causes attributable to Govt. service. ₹2,500/month for boys, ₹3,000/month for girls.
benefits: ₹2,500/month for boys. ₹3,000/month for girls. For professional/technical degree courses (min 60% in qualifying exam).
application_process: 1. Apply at National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Under 'Central Schemes' → PM Scholarship for CAPF. 3. Upload documents including service certificate. 4. Verification by respective Force HQ. 5. Scholarship credited.
source_name: National Scholarship Portal / Ministry of Home Affairs

name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) Loans
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Concessional loans for persons with disabilities for self-employment, education, skill development, and livelihood activities at low interest rates.
detailed_description: NHFDC provides loans at concessional interest rates to persons with disabilities (PwD) for economic development. Term loans for self-employment: 5% p.a. (women with disability: 4% p.a.). Educational loans at 4% p.a. Skill Development loan at 4% p.a. Maximum loan: ₹30 lakh. Implemented through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs).
benefits: Term loan at 5% p.a. (4% for women with disability). Education loan at 4% p.a. Maximum ₹30 lakh. Subsidy component available in some schemes.
application_process: 1. Contact State Channelising Agency (SCA) in your state. 2. Submit loan application with documents. 3. Verification by SCA. 4. Loan sanctioned and disbursed via bank. Visit nhfdc.nic.in for SCA details.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit scheme providing ₹5,000 cash incentive to pregnant and lactating women for first live birth to partially compensate wage loss and improve health and nutrition.
detailed_description: PMMVY provides a cash incentive of ₹5,000 to pregnant women and lactating mothers for the birth of first living child (₹6,000 for 2nd child if girl). Benefit is given in installments linked to antenatal care. Aims to improve health-seeking behavior and provide wage compensation during pregnancy. Implemented through Anganwadi Centres.
benefits: ₹5,000 for first child (in 3 installments). ₹6,000 for second child if girl (in 2 installments). Covers wage loss, nutrition needs.
application_process: 1. Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) within 150 days of last menstrual period. 2. Fill PMMVY application forms 1A, 1B, 1C at AWC. 3. Submit documents. 4. Installments credited after each antenatal visit milestone. Apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
source_name: wcd.nic.in (Ministry of Women and Child Development)
